Generally in dua we use word like "Allah give me so and so as sadaka of so and so (Rasul or auliya)". Is it allow? Question: As salam v alaikum, 1) Is it allow to seek sadak of Rasul-allah (SAW) and other auliya in dua? Generally in dua we use word like "Allah give me so and so as sadaka of so and so(Rasul or auliya)". Is it allow? Answer ID: 7185 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1447/1373=D/1429) Sadqah means wasilah (intermediation). It is lawful to supplicate Allah with the wasilah of the prophets and pious people. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
